snippet.title: Atari Pong Doubles (1973) Gameplay Video
snippet.description: This is the audio/video output from the real 1973 Atari video arcade game Pong Doubles. It is possible to play just the normal 2-player game of Pong by only inserting one coin and pressing start, but if you add two coins you'll get 4 players for two teams of two playing head to head!
